scene_description: A family of four sits around a campfire in the woods. Two adults and two children are seated in camping chairs near a round fire pit. A green tent is visible in the background among tall trees.

questions.question: What is in the middle of the people?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the round bowl on the ground between everyone.

questions.question: Who is sitting in the chairs?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the chairs around the fire.

questions.question: What is behind the people?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the background behind the chairs.

questions.question: Where are the people sitting?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the tall trees all around them.

questions.question: What color are the camping chairs?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the chairs the people are sitting in.
